title: Software Developer (UI/UX)
description:
**Job Title: Software Developer** (UI/UX)
 

**No. of Vacancies:** 1
 

**Job ID:** R0097091


**Experience** 5\-11years
 

**Location:** Pune , Koregaon Park
 

**Full time /Part Time:** Full time
 

**Regular /Temporary:** Regular


**Company Overview:**

**Intelligent Manufacturing** is on an exciting growth journey, building the new digital era of manufacturing. Our digital manufacturing solutions automate and connect the component manufacturing value chain – from design and planning to preparation, production, and verification. Our objective is to make the shift towards efficient and sustainable manufacturing. As the market leader in CAM and metrology software with over 400,000 software licenses and a global footprint, we have a unique foundation to build on. Please read more about us here .


At **Metrologic Group** , part of Sandvik — a global industrial technology leader — we build the software backbone of modern manufacturing quality. Our solutions connect design, production, and inspection into a seamless digital feedback loop, used by 15,000\+ engineers across 60 countries, including the world's top aerospace, automotive, and energy companies.


Somewhere right now, an engineer at an aerospace company is validating a jet engine component. A team at an automotive plant is catching a defect before it reaches the line. A precision manufacturer is closing the loop between their CAD design and the physical world — in real time.


That's possible because of software like ours. And this also shows what software quality means to us.


**Position Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced and highly collaborative UX/UI Specialist to drive the user experience and interface design of Metrologic DCS product portfolio, which includes the next generation MLM Plaform, Metrolog Suite and 3DCS software.


This role will play a key part in shaping a modern, scalable, and intuitive user experience across the digital manufacturing ecosystem, ensuring consistency and workflow alignment between MLM, Inspection Flow, and the broader Metrolog Suite.


The ideal candidate combines strong UX thinking, workflow design expertise, and modern UI capabilities with the ability to understand complex industrial software environments, manufacturing processes, quality workflows, and user personas across engineering, production, metrology, and quality operations.


The UX/UI Specialist will work cross\-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, Application Specialists, Customers, and Marketing to design and transform complex workflows into intuitive, efficient, and customer\-centric experiences.


**Key Responsibilities:**

**UX Strategy \& User Experience Design**

* Lead the UX definition and evolution for the MLM platform as a strategic extension of Inspection Flow and revamping the workflows of existing products
* Design end\-to\-end user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and interaction models.
* Ensure seamless and intuitive navigation across the MLM ecosystem and alignment with the broader Sandvik Intelligent Manufacturing Product Portfolio
* Analyze customer workflows in manufacturing, inspection, quality management, metrology, and engineering environments.
* Translate complex industrial and technical processes into clear and efficient user experiences.
* Drive workflow simplification and usability improvements across the platform portfolio.
* Conduct user research, usability testing, and customer feedback sessions.
* Define and maintain UX standards, interaction guidelines, and design consistency.

**UI Design \& Design System Development**

* Create modern, responsive, and scalable UI concepts aligned with the company's product vision.
* Develop reusable UI components and contribute to a unified design system across Metrolog Suite products.
* Ensure visual consistency between MLM, Inspection Flow, Metrolog, QDM, and other connected applications.
* Collaborate with development teams to ensure accurate implementation of UX/UI concepts.
* Create mock\-ups, clickable prototypes, visual assets, and UI specifications.
* Support the modernization of legacy interfaces where applicable.

**Workflow Alignment Across Metrolog Suite**

* Harmonize workflows and user interactions across the Metrologic\-DCS software ecosystem.
* Identify inconsistencies and propose standardization opportunities across applications.
* Collaborate with Product Managers to align product experiences with strategic platform direction, specific industrial use cases
* Contribute to the definition of common navigation principles, terminology, and user interaction patterns.
* Support integration scenarios between MLM, Inspection Flow, Metrolog, and adjacent solutions.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Product Management to translate business strategy and customer needs into UX/UI requirements.
* Collaborate with software architects and engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.
* Partner with application specialists and customers to validate usability and workflow efficiency.
* Support customer demonstrations, workshops, and innovation sessions when needed.
* Contribute to agile product development processes.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, master’s in computer applications (MCA), or equivalent qualification *.*

**Required Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of experience in creation of industrial context and business portfolio
* Proven technical knowledge in Figma and good understanding of latest tools for creating UI/UX
* Proven experience designing workflows and interfaces for complex B2B or industrial software environments.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating UX process, workflow optimization, and UI design capabilities.
* Strong understanding of usability principles, interaction design, and responsive design.
* Understanding industrial workflows and engineering user personas.
* Ability to translate technical concepts into intuitive user experiences.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English, French would be a plus

**What Success Looks Like in This Role :**

A successful Software Developer will:


Deliver high‑quality, stable, and scalable software features aligned with business and customer needs.


Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code that meets defined coding and architectural standards.


Actively contributes to design decisions that improve usability, performance, and system architecture.


Collaborate effectively with QA and cross‑functional teams to ensure timely and defect‑free releases.


Proactively identify and resolve technical issues, minimizing rework and technical debt.


Contribute to continuous improvement through innovation, refactoring, and process enhancements.


Be recognized as a reliable team player and technical contributor, supporting both project delivery and team growth.


You don’t need to know metrology on “day one” – but you will find it genuinely fascinating – we promise!


continuous improvement by refining testing practices and processes over time.


**A glimpse of our culture**

At Sandvik, we're tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial! For us, success is a team effort \- we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. We also give you the freedom to find that perfect mix between work, family life and interests. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.


**Why Join Us**

**Real impact** — your code runs in factories, labs, and quality departments at companies


**Global team, local home** — Pune\-based role with genuine collaboration with engineering teams in Europe and worldwide


**Technical depth** — complex domain, interesting problems, room to grow and develop


**Stability and scale** — backed by Sandvik, a 160\-year\-old industrial technology company operating in 150\+ countries


**Room to lead** — as the Pune team grows, so does the opportunity to take on more ownership


**How to apply:**

You may upload your updated profile in Workday against the R0097091through your login, no later than 1st October 2026 Or Please send your application by registering on our site www.sandvik.com/career and uploading your CV against the R0097091 1st October 2026


Our recruitment process is open and fair – we welcome all applicants and evaluate every unique application in line with the specified requirements profile, to find the best match for the position. To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site.

title: Junior Interior Designer
description:
Job Description – Junior Interior Designer

**Position:** Junior Interior Designer  
**Department:** Interior Design  
**Location:** Pune  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **Junior Interior Designer** to support our interior design team in developing and executing residential, commercial, and workplace interior projects. The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of design, drawings, materials, and site execution, along with the ability to coordinate effectively with internal and external teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in designing **residential, commercial, and workplace interior projects**.
* Prepare **concept presentations, mood boards, material palettes, and design presentations**.
* Develop detailed drawings including **layouts, furniture plans, elevations, sections, and working drawings**.
* Coordinate with **Senior Designers, Architects, Consultants, Vendors, and Site Teams** to ensure smooth project execution.
* Conduct **site visits** for measurements, execution monitoring, and quality checks.
* Assist in the selection of **materials, finishes, furniture, lighting, and décor elements** as per project requirements.
* Ensure drawings and design documents are **updated based on site changes and client requirements**.
* Support the preparation of **BOQs, material specifications, and project documentation**.
* Maintain organized **project files, drawings, and documentation**.
* Coordinate assigned tasks and ensure **timely completion of project deliverables**.
* Support the senior design team throughout the project lifecycle, from concept development to execution.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's/Diploma in **Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field**.
* Good knowledge of **AutoCAD, SketchUp, and relevant design/presentation software**.
* Understanding of **interior materials, finishes, furniture, and construction details**.
* Good design sense with attention to **detail, functionality, and aesthetics**.
* Ability to read and understand **technical and working drawings**.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Willingness to travel for **site visits** as required.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and work within project timelines.

Preferred Experience

**2\-5 years of relevant experience** in interior design or architectural/interior projects.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on diverse **residential, commercial, and workplace projects**.
* Exposure to the complete interior design process from **concept to execution**.
* Collaborative and professional work environment.
* Opportunities for learning and professional growth.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: UI/UX Developer
description:
**Job Description: UI/UX Developer (0\-2 Years of Experience)**

**Company Overview**

We are seeking a talented and detail\-oriented **UI/UX Developer** to join our team. As a UI/UX Developer, you will be responsible for transforming UI/UX designs into responsive, interactive, and high\-performance web applications while ensuring an exceptional user experience. You will work closely with UI/UX designers, product managers, and backend developers to develop intuitive, visually appealing, and user\-friendly digital products. This position is ideal for someone with **1–4 years of experience** in front\-end development who is passionate about creating seamless user experiences and building modern, scalable web applications using the latest front\-end technologies.

**Position: UI/UX Developer**

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Design modern, responsive Web \& Mobile UI/UX in **Figma \& develop in Ionic**.
* Use **Google Stitch** to generate UI concepts and convert them into production\-ready Figma designs.
* **Strictly follow the existing THS Design System** reuse components, colors, typography, and layouts.
* Create developer\-ready designs in **Ionic, Angular, HTML \& CSS** implementation.
* Collaborate with Product, BA, and Development teams to deliver intuitive, consistent user experiences.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* **Experience:** 0\-2 years of hands\-on experience in Ionic framework development.

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong expertise in **Figma** and Design Systems.
* Experience with **Google Stitch** UI generation tools.
* Good understanding of **Ionic, Angular, HTML5, and CSS3**.
* Knowledge of responsive, mobile\-first, and enterprise application design.

**Soft Skills:**

* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.

**Education**

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

**Location**

This position is based at our office in Pune, Maharashtra.

**How to Apply**

If you are excited about this opportunity and meet the requirements mentioned above, we would love to hear from you! Please send your resume along with any relevant project portfolio or GitHub profile to hr@thsystems.co.in or poojas@thsystems.co.in

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
